verdict.rationale: Mercury provides webhooks for event-driven automation, an API/CLI/MCP for programmatic financial actions, and AI-agent skills (mercury-analyze-spend, mercury-detect-anomaly) that could run autonomously, but these are developer-oriented building blocks rather than a native scheduler/rules engine for background automations aimed at an 'AI-native user' persona (e.g., no evidence of scheduled/triggered agent workflows running unattended within the product UI). missing for 10: a first-party scheduling/trigger system for autonomous background runs, documented always-on agent execution, and independent evidence of such automations actually running unattended.
